posts.text:
Your best idea will not arrive between the 40th and 41st email.

It arrives when your head has room.

Where do your best ideas come from?

#Founders #Focus #Creativity
The right support makes the work lighter, not smaller. What is your heaviest sandbag?

Even a lighthouse has a keeper.

The light looks effortless from the sea. Someone is polishing the lens, carrying supplies and checking the lamp every night.

Who keeps your light on?

#Leadership #Entrepreneurs #Teamwork
